```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  fig.align = "center"
)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(pointblank)
library(survival)
library(gtsummary)
library(survminer)
library(gt)
library(scales)

# Load the robustrwd package
devtools::load_all(here::here("robustrwd"))
be_quiet()

# Custom colors
plinth_blue <- "#4783F1"
plinth_green <- "#28a745"
plinth_red <- "#dc3545"
plinth_orange <- "#fd7e14"
plinth_gray <- "#6c757d"
```

```{r load-data}
# Load PROBLEMATIC data (Delivery 01 + ETL v01) - has known issues
tables_v1 <- receive_delivery_01()
tables_v1_etl <- tables_v1 %>% etl_01()

# Load CLEAN data (Delivery 02 + ETL v02) - issues resolved
tables_v2 <- receive_delivery_02()
tables_v2_etl <- tables_v2 %>% etl_02()

# Create ORPP table from clean data
orpp_tbl <- tables_v2_etl$patients %>%
  add_orpp_inpatient(inpatient_tbl = tables_v2_etl$inpatient) %>%
  add_orpp_prescription(prescription_tbl = tables_v2_etl$prescription)
```

# Executive Summary {.tabset}

## Overview

<div class="summary-box">

This report demonstrates a comprehensive data quality assessment and cohort analysis pipeline for Medicare claims data.

**Key Highlights:**

- **Automated Validation**: Data quality checks using the `pointblank` framework
- **Issue Detection**: Identified critical data quality issues in initial delivery
- **Remediation Tracking**: Before/after comparison showing issue resolution
- **Analysis Pipeline**: Complete workflow from raw data to survival analysis

</div>

## Key Metrics

```{r key-metrics}
tibble(
  Metric = c("Total Patients", "Inpatient Claims", "Prescription Records", "Outpatient Claims"),
  `Initial Delivery` = comma(c(
    nrow(tables_v1_etl$patients),
    nrow(tables_v1_etl$inpatient),
    nrow(tables_v1_etl$prescription),
    nrow(tables_v1_etl$outpatient)
  )),
  `Corrected Delivery` = comma(c(
    nrow(tables_v2_etl$patients),
    nrow(tables_v2_etl$inpatient),
    nrow(tables_v2_etl$prescription),
    nrow(tables_v2_etl$outpatient)
  ))
) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Data Volume Comparison**"),
    subtitle = "Record counts across data deliveries"
  ) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(14))
```

---

# Data Quality Issues Detected {.tabset}

<div class="summary-box" style="border-left-color: #dc3545;">

**Initial Data Delivery (v01)** underwent automated validation and **multiple critical issues were detected**. These findings triggered a data remediation request to the provider and an internal ETL code review.

</div>

## Patient Data Issues

```{r patients-issues}
patients_agent_v1 <- tables_v1_etl$patients %>%
  create_agent(
    tbl_name = "Patients (Initial Delivery)",
    label = "Patient Data - Issues Detected"
  ) %>%
  expectations_patients() %>%
  interrogate()

patients_agent_v1
```

### Issues Identified:

```{r patients-issues-detail}
issues_v1 <- patients_agent_v1 %>%
  get_agent_x_list()

tibble(
  Issue = c(
    "Patients with birth dates before 1900",
    "Missing cancer indicator diversity",
    "Missing mortality data",
    "Missing sex diversity (ETL bug)"
  ),
  Severity = c("High", "Medium", "High", "Critical"),
  `Records Affected` = c(
    issues_v1$n_failed[2],
    "100% same value",
    "0 deaths recorded",
    "100% Male only"
  ),
  Resolution = c(
    "Data provider correction",
    "Data provider correction",
    "Data provider correction",
    "Internal ETL code fix"
  )
) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = md("**Patient Data Issues Summary**")) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = Severity,
    colors = scales::col_factor(
      palette = c("Critical" = plinth_red, "High" = plinth_orange, "Medium" = "#ffc107"),
      domain = c("Critical", "High", "Medium")
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

## Inpatient Claims Issues

```{r inpatient-issues}
inpatient_agent_v1 <- tables_v1_etl$inpatient %>%
  create_agent(
    tbl_name = "Inpatient Claims (Initial Delivery)",
    label = "Inpatient Data - Issues Detected"
  ) %>%
  expectations_inpatient() %>%
  interrogate()

inpatient_agent_v1
```

### Negative Payment Investigation

```{r negative-payments}
negative_claims <- tables_v1_etl$inpatient %>%
  filter(clm_pmt_amt < 0)

negative_claims %>%
  head(10) %>%
  select(desynpuf_id, clm_id, clm_from_dt, clm_pmt_amt) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Sample of Negative Payment Claims**"),
    subtitle = glue::glue("{nrow(negative_claims)} records with negative payments detected")
  ) %>%
  fmt_currency(columns = clm_pmt_amt, decimals = 2) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#ffcccc"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = clm_pmt_amt)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
```

```{r patients-clean}

patients_agent_v2
```

## Inpatient Claims - Resolved

```{r inpatient-clean}
inpatient_agent_v2 <- tables_v2_etl$inpatient %>%

inpatient_agent_v2
```

## ORPP Derived Table

```{r orpp-validation}
orpp_agent <- orpp_tbl %>%
  create_agent(
    tbl_name = "One Row Per Patient",
    label = "Derived ORPP Table Validation"
  ) %>%
  expectations_orpp() %>%
  interrogate()

orpp_agent
```

## Validation Comparison

```{r validation-comparison}
comparison_df <- tibble(
  Table = c("Patients", "Patients", "Inpatient", "Inpatient"),
  Version = c("Initial (v01)", "Corrected (v02)", "Initial (v01)", "Corrected (v02)"),
  `Total Tests` = c(
    nrow(patients_agent_v1$validation_set),
    nrow(patients_agent_v2$validation_set),
    nrow(inpatient_agent_v1$validation_set),
    nrow(inpatient_agent_v2$validation_set)
  ),
  `Tests Passed` = c(
    sum(patients_agent_v1$validation_set$all_passed),
    sum(patients_agent_v2$validation_set$all_passed),
    sum(inpatient_agent_v1$validation_set$all_passed),
    sum(inpatient_agent_v2$validation_set$all_passed)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    `Pass Rate` = percent(`Tests Passed` / `Total Tests`),
    Status = if_else(`Tests Passed` == `Total Tests`, "PASS", "FAIL")
  )

comparison_df %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Before vs After: Validation Results**"),
    subtitle = "Comparison of data quality across deliveries"
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = Status,
    colors = scales::col_factor(
      palette = c("PASS" = plinth_green, "FAIL" = plinth_red),
      domain = c("PASS", "FAIL")
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_row_group(label = "Inpatient Claims", rows = 3:4) %>%
  tab_row_group(label = "Patient Demographics", rows = 1:2) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(14))
```

# Patient Demographics {.tabset}

## Population Overview

```{r demographics-table}
tables_v2_etl$patients %>%
  select(sex_ident_cd, race_cd, diabetes, cncr, esrd_ind, death_observed) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label = list(
      sex_ident_cd ~ "Sex",
      race_cd ~ "Race/Ethnicity",
      diabetes ~ "Diabetes",
      cncr ~ "Cancer History",
      esrd_ind ~ "End-Stage Renal Disease",
      death_observed ~ "Deceased"
    ),
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)")
  ) %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Characteristic**") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Patient Population Characteristics**"),
    subtitle = glue::glue("N = {comma(nrow(tables_v2_etl$patients))} patients")
  )
```

## Sex Distribution Comparison

```{r sex-comparison, fig.height=5}
bind_rows(
  tables_v1_etl$patients %>%
    count(sex_ident_cd) %>%
    mutate(Version = "Initial Delivery (Bug)"),
  tables_v2_etl$patients %>%
    count(sex_ident_cd) %>%
    mutate(Version = "Corrected Delivery")
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sex_ident_cd, y = n, fill = Version)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = comma(n)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Sex Distribution: Before vs After ETL Fix",
    subtitle = "Initial delivery showed ETL bug converting all patients to 'Male'",
    x = "Sex",
    y = "Number of Patients"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Initial Delivery (Bug)" = plinth_red,
                                "Corrected Delivery" = plinth_green))
```

## Race/Ethnicity

```{r race-distribution, fig.height=5}
tables_v2_etl$patients %>%
  count(race_cd, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = n / sum(n),
    race_cd = fct_reorder(race_cd, n)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = race_cd, y = n, fill = race_cd)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(comma(n), " (", percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1), ")")),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Patient Distribution by Race/Ethnicity",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Patients"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
```

# Cohort Definition & Attrition

## Inclusion Criteria

```{r criteria-table}
tibble(
  Step = 1:6,
  Criterion = c(
    "Race is White or Black",
    "Has Diabetes diagnosis",
    "Sex is Male",
    "Median inpatient payment >= $10,000",
    "Median prescription cost > $20",
    "At least 18 years of known survival"
  ),
  Rationale = c(
    "Focus on populations with sufficient sample size",
    "Target population of clinical interest",
    "Subset for focused analysis",
    "Patients with significant healthcare utilization",
    "Patients with ongoing medication needs",
    "Adequate follow-up for survival analysis"
  )
) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Cohort Inclusion Criteria**")
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    Step ~ px(60),
    Criterion ~ px(300),
    Rationale ~ px(350)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

## Attrition Analysis

```{r attrition-table}
attrition_tbl <- create_attrition(
  orpp_tbl,
  "Race is White or Black" = race_cd %in% c("White", "Black"),
  "Has Diabetes" = diabetes == TRUE,
  "Sex is Male" = sex_ident_cd == "Male",
  "Median inpatient payment >= $10,000" = inpatient_payment_median >= 10000,
  "Median prescription cost > $20" = prescription_rx_cost_median > 20,
  "18+ years of known survival" = survival_years >= 18
)

attrition_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    `Retention Rate` = percent(n / first(n), accuracy = 0.1),
    n = comma(n),
    n_dropped = comma(n_dropped)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Criterion = description,
    `Patients Remaining` = n,
    `Patients Excluded` = n_dropped
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Cohort Attrition Summary**"),
    subtitle = "Sequential application of inclusion criteria"
  ) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13)) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "-")
```

## Attrition Visualization

```{r attrition-plot, fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
plot_attrition(attrition_tbl, title = "Cohort Attrition Flow") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```

# Final Cohort Analysis {.tabset}

```{r final-cohort}
cohort_tbl <- orpp_tbl %>%
  filter(
    race_cd %in% c("White", "Black"),
    diabetes == TRUE,
    sex_ident_cd == "Male",
    inpatient_payment_median >= 10000,
    prescription_rx_cost_median > 20,
    survival_years >= 18
  )
```

## Cohort Characteristics

```{r cohort-summary}
cohort_tbl %>%
  select(
    race_cd,
    survival_years,
    death_observed,
    inpatient_payment_median,
    prescription_rx_cost_median,
    inpatient_claims_n,
    prescription_n
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = race_cd,
    label = list(
      survival_years ~ "Survival Time (years)",
      death_observed ~ "Death Observed",
      inpatient_payment_median ~ "Median Inpatient Payment ($)",
      prescription_rx_cost_median ~ "Median Rx Cost ($)",
      inpatient_claims_n ~ "Number of Inpatient Claims",
      prescription_n ~ "Number of Prescriptions"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(all_continuous() ~ 1)
  ) %>%
  add_overall() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Final Cohort Characteristics by Race**"),
    subtitle = glue::glue("N = {nrow(cohort_tbl)} patients meeting all inclusion criteria")
  )
```

## Survival Analysis

```{r survival-analysis, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
fit <- survfit(
  Surv(survival_years, death_observed) ~ race_cd,
  data = cohort_tbl
)

ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  data = cohort_tbl,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.col = "strata",
  risk.table.height = 0.25,
  surv.median.line = "hv",
  palette = c(plinth_blue, plinth_orange),
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14),
  title = "Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves by Race",
  xlab = "Time (Years)",
  ylab = "Survival Probability",
  legend.title = "Race",
  legend.labs = c("Black", "White"),
  font.title = c(16, "bold"),
  font.x = 14,
  font.y = 14,
  font.tickslab = 12
)
```

## Healthcare Utilization

```{r utilization-plot, fig.height=6}
cohort_tbl %>%
  select(race_cd, inpatient_payment_median, prescription_rx_cost_median) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(inpatient_payment_median, prescription_rx_cost_median),
    names_to = "cost_type",
    values_to = "amount"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cost_type = case_when(
      cost_type == "inpatient_payment_median" ~ "Inpatient Payments",
      cost_type == "prescription_rx_cost_median" ~ "Prescription Costs"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = race_cd, y = amount, fill = race_cd)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~cost_type, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Healthcare Cost Distribution by Race",
    subtitle = "Median values per patient",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Amount ($)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Black" = plinth_blue, "White" = plinth_orange))
```

# Summary & Recommendations

<div class="summary-box">

## Data Quality Findings

| Category | Initial Status | Final Status |
|----------|---------------|--------------|
| Patient Demographics | **4 Critical Issues** | All Resolved |
| Inpatient Claims | **104 Invalid Records** | All Resolved |
| ORPP Derived Data | N/A | All Validations Pass |

## Key Actions Taken

1. **Data Provider Notification**: Reported birth date anomalies, missing cancer/death indicators
2. **Internal ETL Fix**: Corrected sex mapping bug in `etl_patients_01()`
3. **Re-delivery Request**: Obtained corrected data delivery (v02)
4. **Validation Confirmation**: All automated checks now pass

## Recommendations

- Continue automated validation on all future data deliveries
- Implement real-time alerting for critical validation failures
- Expand validation rules to cover additional data quality dimensions

</div>

# Appendix {.tabset}

## Data Pipeline

```{r pipeline-diagram, fig.height=4}
tibble(
  step = 1:5,
  stage = c("Raw Data\nDelivery", "ETL\nProcessing", "Validation\n(pointblank)", "ORPP\nDerivation", "Analysis\nCohort"),
  status = c("Input", "Transform", "Validate", "Derive", "Output")
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = step, y = 1)) +
  geom_point(size = 20, color = plinth_blue) +
  geom_text(aes(label = stage), color = "white", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = step + 0.3, xend = step + 0.7, y = 1, yend = 1),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               data = . %>% filter(step < 5),
               color = plinth_gray) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Data Processing Pipeline") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
```
